feature: Independently timed provisional translations during native streaming ASR

semantics.clock: Wall time from the first untranslated source update; subsequent tokens do not postpone the deadline
semantics.pending_work: One active translation; latest source revision coalesced for the next update
semantics.finalization: Wake pending timer, publish final source, join in-flight translation, translate final revision or reuse an exact match
semantics.history: Only finalized source/translation pairs enter later translation context
semantics.privacy: Existing memory-only transport and startup privacy policy preserved

real_gpu_browser.input: Existing 26-second Japanese clip from the user-provided test video; file processing, not realtime pacing
real_gpu_browser.timing_scope: Includes timer, inference and browser delivery after first source text; excludes model loading. Small-sample timings, not a universal latency guarantee.
